messages:
alex_svc: Hey team — customer hit a spike of 429s during checkout and reported duplicate charges. They're using our JS SDK (v1.2.0) with default settings. Can this SDK retry behavior cause duplicates for non-idempotent endpoints?

maria: Sorry to hear that. Which endpoint exactly and can you paste the request/response headers and the SDK config they used?

alex_svc: Endpoint: POST /v1/charges (server-side). Customer said they used the hosted SDK call from our example server. Snippet of response headers they captured:

```
Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXX
User-Agent: redwood-sdk-js/1.2.0
Content-Type: application/json
\nHTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 2
X-Request-Id: req_01F2ABCD
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
```

alex_svc: They didn't set an Idempotency-Key. They also attached an excerpt of their server logs showing 3 near-simultaneous attempts for the same checkout request.

tim: Thanks — couple things. By default the JS SDK in 1.2.0 had retries enabled for transient network errors and 5xx, and it would also retry on 429s if Retry-After was missing. For non-idempotent endpoints like /charges, that's dangerous if the client doesn't send an Idempotency-Key.

tim: Quick mitigation: ask the customer to either generate and send an Idempotency-Key header per logical operation or to disable auto-retries for the create-charge call. Example header we recommend:

```
Idempotency-Key: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6
```

maria: Can you give the exact SDK config change they can apply? We should provide a one-liner.
\
tim: Sure. For the node SDK you can pass opts when constructing the client or per-call. Two safe options:
1) Disable retries for the specific call:
```
client.createCharge(payload, { retries: 0 })
```
2) Send an idempotency key (preferred):
```
client.createCharge(payload, { headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': uuidv4() } })
```

tim: Backoff guidance if they keep retries: use exponential backoff with full jitter, base=500ms, cap=6000ms, maxAttempts=3 for non-idempotent ops. For idempotent ops you can raise attempts to 5. Always honor Retry-After if present (server TTL should win).

alex_svc: They do have a feature flag in their app that sets ENABLE_AUTO_RETRY=true at deploy time. So the SDK retries were being toggled on globally. That's the likely root cause.

maria: OK I'll tell the customer to disable that flag for checkout or add idempotency keys while we investigate. Also requesting their request ids and the times so billing can reconcile duplicates.

jess-billing: I've created a billing ticket (BILL-4721). Please add the request ids and customer invoice id. If duplicates are confirmed we'll refund the extras.

tim: Action item for SDK team: we'll ship a patch to default to not retry on 429s for recognized non-idempotent endpoints and surface a warning when auto-retry is enabled client-wide. Also add clearer logs when a retry is executed for a request lacking Idempotency-Key.

maria: Can you also ask them to enable SDK debug logs and share them? Command for node env: `DEBUG=redwood-sdk:* node server.js` — ask them to redact keys.

ops-bot: deploy-logger: patch 1.2.1 -> staging started by @tim at 2025-12-12T14:22:00Z :rocket:

alex_svc: Thanks all. I'll send the customer the short remediation steps (disable global auto-retry on checkout OR add Idempotency-Key per charge) and request the logs + request ids. Will follow up with billing ticket details. :thumbsup:
